Chief_Complaint.content: Acute lip swelling after eating prawn soup
Chief_Complaint.source_text: CC: acute lip swelling after eating prawn soup

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Lip swelling began about 30 minutes after eating prawn soup
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Onset: ate prawn soup ~19:00; swelling began ~30 min after

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Swelling started at the left corner of the lip and progressed to involve the upper lip
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: swelling began ~30 min after; started left corner of lip → now upper lip, progressive

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports difficulty breathing described as 'can't breathe that well' (dyspnea)
Prior similar episode about 1 year ago after food with overnight swelling and breathing difficulty
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: prior similar episode ~1 yr ago after food with overnight swelling and breathing difficulty

Past_Medical_History.content: History of prior severe allergic reaction as a child at approximately age 6
Past_Medical_History.source_text: prior severe allergic reaction as child (age ~6)

Medications.content: Sometimes takes antihistamines, exact type unknown to patient
No antihistamines initially on person during current episode
Medications.source_text: Current meds/available: no antihistamines on person

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient was initially alone during the episode
Patient's mother arrived during the episode

Social_and_Family_History.source_text: someone (mother) arrived and will call emergency services

Assessment.content: Suspected anaphylaxis or allergic angioedema due to progressive lip swelling after prawn ingestion with respiratory symptoms and dizziness and prior severe allergic reaction and peanut allergy
Assessment.source_text: 1. Suspected anaphylaxis / allergic angioedema — progressive lip swelling after prawn ingestion with respiratory symptoms (dyspnea, chest tightness) and dizziness; prior history of severe allergic reaction and peanut allergy.

Assessment.content: Asthma with baseline salbutamol use that may exacerbate respiratory compromise
Assessment.source_text: 2. Asthma — baseline salbutamol user; may exacerbate respiratory compromise.

Plan_of_Care.content: Ambulance or 999 to be contacted for emergency response
Attendant to remain with patient until EMS arrival
Plan_of_Care.source_text: attendant to remain with patient until EMS arrival

Plan_of_Care.content: Doctor initiated ambulance request and instructed attendant to call 999
Plan_of_Care.source_text: (doctor initiated ambulance request and instructed attendant to call 999)

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient to take available oral antihistamine immediately as located by attendant
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Interim: take available oral antihistamine immediately as located by attendant.

Plan_of_Care.content: Urgent emergency department assessment and treatment for suspected anaphylaxis
Plan_of_Care.source_text: ED: urgent assessment and treatment for suspected anaphylaxis

Plan_of_Care.content: Emergency department may administer injection or epinephrine
Patient to contact service after hospital discharge to arrange further anaphylaxis management
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Follow-up: patient to contact service after hospital discharge to arrange further anaphylaxis management

Plan_of_Care.content: Possible prescription of adrenaline auto-injector after follow-up

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient to contact the service after hospital discharge
Follow_up_Information.source_text: Follow-up: patient to contact service after hospital discharge
